fn substitute_internal<'a>(
    variable_value: &'a VariableValue,
    property_id: Option<PropertyIdRef>,
    substitution_functions: &'a ComputedSubstitutionFunctions,
    stylist: &Stylist,
    computed_context: &computed::Context,
    attribute_tracker: &mut AttributeTracker,
    seen: &mut SmallVec<[&'a Name; 8]>,
    attr_taint: Option<&mut AttrTaint>,
) -> Result<Substitution<'a>, ()> {
    do_substitute_chunk(
        &variable_value.css,
        /* start = */ 0,
        /* end = */ variable_value.css.len(),
        variable_value.first_token_type,
        variable_value.last_token_type,
        &variable_value.url_data,
        property_id,
        substitution_functions,
        stylist,
        computed_context,
        &variable_value.references.refs,
        attribute_tracker,
        seen,
        attr_taint,
    )
}

/// Replace var(), env(), and attr() functions, returning the resulting CSS string.
new_native_prototype: css-resumable-substitution-prototype-v1 remains unsealed and is not authenticated or refined by this model

mapping.Control.eval: Abstract expression cursor; not native token parser
mapping.Control.await: Outstanding name/fallback request; exact state retained across Pending
mapping.Frame.left/right: Pending child and retained completed left tokens
mapping.Resolution.tokens: Settled-invalid or final token list; Pending is separate outer Option
mapping.reads: Logical value reads, not CSS semantic graph or parser side effects
mapping.polls: Finite sequence of real machine ticks and stalls under immutable settled bindings
mapping.completion: Existing CompletedPrefix.resolve plus continuation stack, not arbitrary evaluator agreement
mapping.alias: Separately settled output; prior completed_alias_extension provenance remains required
mapping.conditional_progress: Structural rank proves finish only under fixed env with resolver Some; no eventual producer/native cycle progress

excluded: raw and typed attr two-stage requests
